question: Can a fixed compositional rule hypothesis predict novel contexts from four labeled demonstrations, outperforming context-table memorization under equal calibration-label access?
hypothesis: Under a modular additive family, a one-parameter residual-bias learner will generalize from four initial-pair examples to all other context pairs, whereas a 64-count rote learner using the same four labels cannot cover the unseen contexts.
freeze: All generator, splits, context-limited calibration budget, solver algorithm and rejection controls frozen before scientific first-use; do not tune on heldout test results.
source: Base W-R18 x0=(e+seed)%4, x1=(e//4+3*seed)%4, known dynamic hypothesis x[t]=(x[t-1]+x[t-2]+b)%4. Previously studied b0 and b1; NEW heldout tasks set b2 on fresh seeds64..67.

split.development_model_source: Published W-R18 b0 source identity as known structural hypothesis only, no additional labels

calibration: Per heldout seed exactly four allowed labels at t2 from episodes e0,1,2,3. Their initial x1 is fixed, leaving 12 of 16 initial context pairs without direct first-step calibration. Exclude the four calibration episodes entirely from test.
arms: old_fixed_b0: use known b=0 formula with no new calibration
rote_16_context: 16x4 counting table updated with only four calibration labels; unseen contexts default class0 and all rows have fixed deterministic tie rules
compositional_bias: infer residual offset b=(observed y-xprev1-xprev2)%4 from four calibration labels, accept only if all agree, then use b to predict all test contexts
shuffled_history_compositional: same inferred b and calibration labels, but at test permute only already observed history prefix, destroying chronological relation while preserving symbol multiset
test: Per heldout seed 12 uncalibrated episodes e4..15, t2..31 (30 test predictions each, 360 per seed), compute full 4x4 confusion and track SHA256. Test labels inaccessible to learner.
primary: COMPOSITIONAL_GENERALIZATION if compositional_bias>=.95 and all three controls<=.65; PARTIAL if compositional outperforms every control but misses threshold; NEGATIVE otherwise; invalid if calibration examples fail agreed rule.
capacity: Rote 64 integer counters; compositional one integer parameter b plus formula fixed before run. Not equal parameter capacity; same four new-rule calibration labels and same heldout evaluation observations. Model calls0, no hidden capacity growth.
safeguards: No future observations in shuffled control, no heldout-label access during calibration, no tuning, no original first-use reruns, exact SHA identities, deterministic replay and full test/build.
claim_limit: Finite predetermined modular-additive hypothesis transfer with four supervised examples, not discovering arbitrary dynamics or generic reasoning.
